name: Meiji wa yuri
source:
This short Yuri-themed French VN takes place in 1870, after the transition to the Meiji era in Japan.

A young French woman, who had taken to the expeditionary force sent by France to support the Shogun, finds herself idle after the defeat. She decided to join the restaurant founded by another soldier. Maybe she will succeed in finding a normal life, and who knows, to find love...
